about: THE SOLUTION CATALOGUE (10 Nov 2026, sales_engineer; founder ledger 1572 and 1579). For each trade family the common situations a customer describes and the two or three solutions an experienced UAE estimator would put to them, each with one reason, the honest trade-off, what must be true first, and the taxonomy service keys (taxonomy_trade_service, '<trade>.<code>') that do that work, so the option a customer chooses names the services matching uses. Written by sales_engineer from established construction practice: no price, no figure, no brand and no supplier anywhere in it (solution_catalogue.test.ts fails on a digit or a currency word). It is reference for the model's own reasoning, never text read out to a customer. Read by _shared/solution_catalogue.ts; checked by scripts/checks/every_solution_option_names_a_taxonomy_service.test.mjs.

problems.situation: an existing wall, partition or board (MDF, plywood, old panelling or a plain plastered wall) that they want to cover or give a new look
problems.qualify: the size (width and height), one face or both, whether it is a wet or humid area, the look they want (wood, marble, plain colour), budget and timing

options.en: PVC or WPC decorative wall panels
options.ar: ألواح جدارية ديكورية من PVC أو WPC
options.why: moisture-proof, fixed quickly over a sound board, many wood, marble and fluted looks
options.trade_off: the joints show and they feel like plastic up close
options.check: the board must be flat and firmly fixed

options.why: the thinnest finish, keeps the existing shape and edges, fast and clean to apply
options.trade_off: needs a smooth sealed surface, and edges can lift or scratch where it is knocked
options.check: dents and joints are filled and sanded first

options.why: paint is the simplest refresh; a laminate facing is the hardest-wearing surface
options.trade_off: paint on MDF needs sealing and shows dents; laminate needs joinery work and edge banding
options.check: MDF is primed with a sealer before paint

problems.situation: a plain wall they want to turn into a feature or accent wall (living room, majlis, reception, bedroom headboard wall)
problems.qualify: the wall size, the style they like (photos help), lighting on it, budget and timing

options.why: the widest choice of patterns and the quickest change
options.trade_off: less resistant to knocks and humidity than panels
options.check: the wall is dry and smooth

options.ar: ألواح جدارية مضلّعة أو ثلاثية الأبعاد
options.why: real depth and texture, and they can hide uneven walls and cables
options.trade_off: they take a few centimetres of the room and cost more than paper or paint
options.check: sockets and switches on that wall are planned before fixing

options.why: seamless, no joints, a hand-made look
options.trade_off: the result depends on the applicator's skill and it is slower to apply
options.check: a sample patch is approved first

problems.situation: rooms or a whole home to repaint (tired walls, a colour change, moving in or out)
problems.qualify: the number of rooms or the area, ceiling height, walls only or ceilings and doors too, colour change from dark to light, furnished or empty, budget and timing

options.why: the usual move-in or move-out finish, quick and economical
options.trade_off: marks easily and is less washable
options.check: cracks and nail holes are filled first

options.ar: دهان فاخر قابل للغسل (مطفي أو نصف لامع)
options.why: stands up to cleaning, good for children's rooms, corridors and kitchens
options.trade_off: costs more per coat
options.check: a low-odour product where people stay in the home

options.en: Decorative finish on a feature wall
options.why: adds character where plain paint would be flat
options.trade_off: slower and depends on the applicator
options.check: a sample patch is approved first

problems.situation: the outside of a villa or building looks faded, chalky, or has hairline cracks
problems.qualify: villa or building, storeys and access, the wall area, how bad the cracks are, budget and timing

options.en: Exterior repaint with a weather-resistant paint
options.ar: إعادة دهان خارجي بدهان مقاوم للعوامل الجوية
options.why: restores the colour and protects against sun and dust
options.trade_off: hairline cracks can show through again
options.check: the wall is pressure-washed and primed

options.why: bridges hairline cracks and lasts longer in UAE heat
options.trade_off: costs more and changes the look of the surface
options.check: loose plaster is repaired first

options.ar: إصلاح شروخ اللياسة ثم إعادة الدهان
options.why: deals with the cause before the finish
options.trade_off: an extra trade and more time
options.check: a crack wider than a hairline, or one that keeps growing, is seen by an engineer first

problems.situation: paint or wallpaper peeling, bubbling, stained or growing mould from damp
problems.qualify: which wall and room, what is on the other side (bathroom, outside wall, pipes), how long it has been there, the area, budget and timing

options.en: Find and fix the source, then an anti-damp paint system
options.ar: معالجة مصدر الرطوبة ثم نظام دهان مقاوم للرطوبة
options.why: paint alone never cures damp; the leak or seepage is stopped first
options.trade_off: needs leak finding and two trades
options.check: the wall is allowed to dry before painting

options.en: Remove the damaged plaster, replaster and repaint
options.ar: إزالة اللياسة التالفة وإعادة اللياسة والدهان
options.why: salt-damaged plaster keeps blistering whatever paint goes on
options.trade_off: dusty, and the room is out of use for a while
options.check: the source of the damp is already fixed

options.en: Moisture-resistant wall panels after the repair
options.ar: ألواح جدارية مقاومة للرطوبة بعد الإصلاح
options.why: a durable, washable face where some humidity stays (laundry, store room)
options.trade_off: it hides the wall, so a returning leak is noticed late
options.check: never fitted over active damp

problems.situation: a ceiling to lower, to hide pipes, ducts or cables, or to add lighting
problems.qualify: the room sizes and ceiling height, what must stay accessible (AC units, valves), the lighting wanted, budget and timing

options.ar: سقف معلّق من ألواح الجبس المسطّحة
options.why: a clean seamless finish for homes and offices
options.trade_off: access panels are needed wherever services must be reached
options.check: moisture-resistant board in bathrooms and kitchens

options.why: every tile lifts out, so services stay reachable; common in offices and shops
options.trade_off: a commercial look, and the grid shows
options.check: acoustic tiles where noise matters

options.en: Decorative bulkhead with cove or linear lighting
options.ar: سقف ديكوري بإطار جانبي وإضاءة مخفية
options.why: keeps most of the height and adds hidden lighting
options.trade_off: more detailing work and an electrician alongside
options.check: the lighting is planned before the board goes up

problems.situation: a room or an open area to divide into two spaces (an extra bedroom, an office, a meeting room)
problems.qualify: the length and height of the partition, doors in it, privacy or soundproofing needed, natural light to keep, budget and timing

options.why: quick, light and can be insulated for sound
options.trade_off: blocks the light, and heavy items need fixing plates inside
options.check: the building or landlord allows the change

options.why: keeps the daylight and an open feel
options.trade_off: less privacy and less sound reduction unless double-glazed or frosted
options.check: toughened or laminated safety glass only

options.ar: قاطع خشبي مع وحدات تخزين مدمجة
options.why: divides the space and adds shelves or wardrobes at the same time
options.trade_off: thicker and slower to make
options.check: moisture-resistant board where it is humid

problems.situation: a bathroom or kitchen ceiling that is sagging, stained, cracked or growing mould
problems.qualify: which room and its size, whether there is a bathroom or tank above, how long it has been there, budget and timing

options.en: Fix the leak above, then replace with moisture-resistant board
options.ar: إصلاح التسريب في الأعلى ثم الاستبدال بألواح جبس مقاومة للرطوبة
options.why: a stained ceiling almost always means water from above
options.trade_off: needs a plumber and a gypsum installer
options.check: an access panel is added for the pipes

options.why: does not absorb water and wipes clean
options.trade_off: a more utilitarian look
options.check: the leak above is fixed first

problems.situation: an office or shop that needs glass partitions or glass meeting rooms
problems.qualify: the run length and height, number of doors, privacy (frosting or film), sound reduction, landlord rules, budget and timing

options.en: Frameless toughened glass with patch-fitted doors
options.ar: زجاج مقسّى بدون إطارات مع أبواب زجاجية
options.why: the cleanest, most open look
options.trade_off: least sound reduction
options.check: manifestation strips at eye level for safety

options.why: sturdier, takes standard doors and blinds
options.trade_off: the frames show
options.check: the frame colour matches the office

options.why: real privacy for meeting rooms and managers' offices
options.trade_off: heavier and dearer
options.check: the ceiling above is closed off too, or sound passes over

problems.situation: a shower that needs a glass screen or enclosure (a new bathroom, or replacing a curtain or an old screen)
problems.qualify: the shower opening sizes, walk-in or a door, the hardware finish, clear or frosted, budget and timing

options.en: Frameless toughened glass screen or door
options.ar: حاجز أو باب دش من الزجاج المقسّى بدون إطار
options.why: a modern look and easy to clean
options.trade_off: needs level, square walls and good sealing
options.check: toughened safety glass only, never plain annealed glass

options.why: fits tight spaces and seals better
options.trade_off: the tracks need regular cleaning
options.check: toughened safety glass

options.why: no door to break, the simplest option
options.trade_off: some splashing unless the shower is large enough
options.check: the floor falls to the drain

problems.situation: windows that let in heat, noise or dust, or old windows that no longer close well
problems.qualify: the number of windows and their rough sizes, which floor, sliding or hinged, noise or heat the main concern, budget and timing

options.en: New thermal-break aluminium windows with double glazing
options.ar: نوافذ ألمنيوم جديدة بعازل حراري وزجاج مزدوج
options.why: the biggest gain in heat, noise and dust
options.trade_off: the dearest, with some disturbance to the walls
options.check: building or community approval for a change of look

options.why: very good sealing and insulation for homes
options.trade_off: thicker frames and fewer colours than aluminium
options.check: a profile suited to strong sun

options.en: Keep the frames: new seals, adjustment and solar film
options.ar: إبقاء الإطارات مع تجديد العوازل وضبطها وتركيب فيلم حراري
options.why: the cheapest, quickest improvement
options.trade_off: less noise reduction than new double glazing
options.check: the frames are sound

problems.situation: a garage or shop front that needs a new door or shutter, or an old one to automate
problems.qualify: the opening width and height, manual or motorised, insulation, how often it opens, budget and timing

options.why: neat, insulated and quiet for villa garages
options.trade_off: needs headroom inside the garage
options.check: the ceiling height above the opening

options.why: secure and takes little space; usual for shops and stores
options.trade_off: noisier and less insulated
options.check: a box space above the opening

options.why: keeps a sound door and adds a remote
options.trade_off: only worth it if the door is in good condition
options.check: a power point near the opening

problems.situation: floor or wall tiles that are cracked, loose, or sound hollow when tapped
problems.qualify: how many tiles or the area, which room, spare tiles available, whether they want the same look or a change, budget and timing

options.why: least work and mess
options.trade_off: matching old tiles is often impossible, and hollow tiles nearby may follow
options.check: a sample of spare or matching tiles

options.why: fixes the bed underneath and gives a uniform new floor
options.trade_off: noisy, dusty and the room is out of use
options.check: in a wet area, waterproofing is redone under the new tiles

options.en: Overlay: new tiles or SPC vinyl over the sound old floor
options.ar: تركيب أرضية جديدة فوق القديمة (بلاط أو فينيل SPC)
options.why: no demolition, fast
options.trade_off: raises the floor, so doors may need trimming; only over firmly bonded tiles
options.check: the hollow tiles are fixed first

problems.situation: a floor to change or upgrade in living areas or bedrooms
problems.qualify: the area per room, what is there now, children or pets, the look they want, budget and timing

options.why: tough, cool underfoot and easy to clean in the UAE climate
options.trade_off: hard and cold in feel, grout lines show
options.check: a level screed for large tiles

options.ar: أرضيات فينيل SPC أو لامينيت بمظهر الخشب
options.why: warm look, quick to fit, often over the existing floor
options.trade_off: laminate dislikes water; less prestige than real wood
options.check: SPC rather than laminate near water

options.why: a premium natural finish
options.trade_off: the dearest; wood needs care against humidity, marble against stains
options.check: marble is sealed after laying

problems.situation: an outdoor, terrace or pool-side floor that is slippery, too hot underfoot, or worn
problems.qualify: the area, around a pool or not, shade, the look they want, budget and timing

options.why: a high slip rating and low upkeep
options.trade_off: can get hot in direct sun if dark
options.check: a light colour in full sun

options.why: stays cooler and grips well when wet
options.trade_off: needs sealing and costs more
options.check: a flamed or bush-hammered finish, never polished outdoors

options.why: economical, easy to lift and repair
options.trade_off: joints can grow weeds and settle if the base is weak
options.check: a compacted base

problems.situation: a concrete floor in a warehouse, garage, workshop or car park that is dusty, stained or worn
problems.qualify: the area, the traffic (people, cars, forklifts), chemicals or water on it, how long it can be closed, budget and timing

options.why: dust-free, easy to clean and resists oil
options.trade_off: can be slippery when wet without an anti-slip finish
options.check: the concrete is dry and ground first

options.ar: طبقة بولي يوريثان أو ذاتية التسوية
options.why: tougher under heavy traffic and heat
options.trade_off: dearer than a coating
options.check: the expected loads are known

options.ar: جلي الخرسانة ومعالجتها بمادة مانعة للغبار
options.why: the most economical dust-proofing
options.trade_off: less colour and protection than a coating
options.check: cracks are repaired first

problems.situation: marble floors or tops that look dull, scratched, etched or stained
problems.qualify: the area, which rooms, the kind of damage, furnished or empty, budget and timing

options.why: brings back the shine and removes most scratches
options.trade_off: wet work over a few days
options.check: a test area first

options.why: stops new stains on stone in good condition
options.trade_off: does not remove deep scratches
options.check: renewed periodically

options.en: Replace cracked or badly stained pieces
options.why: the only fix for cracks and deep stains
options.trade_off: matching the stone can be hard
options.check: the same stone is still available

problems.situation: a kitchen or vanity worktop to choose (new kitchen, replacement, or a chipped or stained top)
problems.qualify: the run lengths, sink and hob cut-outs, the look they want, how heavily the kitchen is used, budget and timing

options.why: non-porous, consistent colour, very low upkeep
options.trade_off: avoid hot pans directly on it
options.check: templated on site after the cabinets are fixed

options.why: natural, very hard and heat-resistant
options.trade_off: needs sealing; patterns vary slab to slab
options.check: the slab is chosen in person

options.why: heat and stain proof, thin and modern
options.trade_off: edges chip if knocked; needs a skilled fabricator
options.check: edge detail agreed before cutting

problems.situation: a roof or terrace that leaks or seeps into the rooms below, especially after rain or AC condensate
problems.qualify: the roof area, what is on it now (tiles, old membrane, AC units), where the water shows inside, access, budget and timing

options.ar: عزل بلفائف بيتومينية بالتسخين مع طبقة حماية
options.why: a proven, robust roof system
options.trade_off: heavy work; needs a protective screed or tiles over it
options.check: the old layers are assessed and the falls to drains corrected

options.why: seamless around AC stands and pipes, often over the existing roof
options.trade_off: the life depends on the thickness applied and UV exposure
options.check: a UV-stable top coat if left exposed

options.en: Membrane with insulation boards on top (inverted roof)
options.ar: عزل مائي مع ألواح عزل حراري فوقه
options.why: stops the leak and cuts heat into the top floor
options.trade_off: the most work and adds weight
options.check: the roof can take the added layers

problems.situation: a bathroom, kitchen or balcony leaking into the room, ceiling or flat below
problems.qualify: which room, when it shows (after showers, all the time), the age of the bathroom, whether they want a renovation anyway, budget and timing

options.en: Leak detection, then repair the pipe or drain
options.ar: كشف التسريب ثم إصلاح الأنبوب أو الصرف
options.why: often the cause is a pipe or a drain joint, not the floor
options.trade_off: some tiles may be opened
options.check: a pressure test of the supply lines

options.en: Strip, waterproof the wet area and retile
options.ar: إزالة البلاط وعزل المنطقة الرطبة وإعادة التبليط
options.why: the lasting cure when the original membrane has failed
options.trade_off: the bathroom is out of use for days
options.check: a flood test before tiling

options.en: Regrout with epoxy grout and reseal joints
options.ar: إعادة الترويب بترويبة إيبوكسي وتجديد السيليكون
options.why: fixes seepage through tired grout and silicone at little cost
options.trade_off: does not cure a failed membrane or a pipe leak
options.check: only when the source is the joints

problems.situation: a basement, ground-floor wall or boundary wall that is damp, with salts or peeling paint near the ground
problems.qualify: the wall length and height, inside or outside, new or existing building, access to the outside face, budget and timing

options.en: External membrane on the outside face
options.ar: عزل خارجي على الوجه الخارجي للجدار
options.why: stops water at the source
options.trade_off: needs excavation or outside access
options.check: drainage at the wall foot

options.ar: عزل داخلي بمواد بلّورية أو إسمنتية
options.why: done from inside, no digging
options.trade_off: treats the symptom side, not the source
options.check: the wall is sound concrete or block

options.ar: حقن عازل للرطوبة الصاعدة ثم إعادة اللياسة
options.why: for rising damp in walls
options.trade_off: the plaster must be renewed afterwards
options.check: a plumbing leak is ruled out first

problems.situation: weak water pressure in showers or taps, or pressure that drops when two taps run
problems.qualify: villa or apartment, tank on the roof or mains, the age of the pipes, all taps or some, budget and timing

options.en: Booster pump with a pressure vessel
options.ar: مضخة تقوية ضغط مع خزان ضغط
options.why: the usual fix when the supply is from a roof tank
options.trade_off: a pump to service and some noise
options.check: space and power near the tank

options.en: Clean the tank and descale the lines, aerators and mixers
options.ar: تنظيف الخزان وإزالة الترسبات من الخطوط والخلاطات
options.why: scale and sediment often choke the flow
options.trade_off: does not help if the pipes are undersized
options.check: the tank is cleaned and disinfected

options.why: the lasting cure for corroded or undersized pipes
options.trade_off: opens walls and floors
options.check: done with a bathroom renovation if one is planned

problems.situation: no hot water, a water heater leaking or tripping, or hot water that runs out
problems.qualify: the heater size and age, where it sits, how many bathrooms, budget and timing

options.en: Replace the water heater like for like
options.why: quick, and old heaters are rarely worth repairing
options.trade_off: the same running cost as before
options.check: the safety valve and drain are renewed too

options.ar: سخان بمضخة حرارية أو بالطاقة الشمسية
options.why: much lower running cost for a family home
options.trade_off: higher first cost and needs roof or outdoor space
options.check: roof access and orientation

options.why: no waiting and no storage tank
options.trade_off: needs a strong electrical supply per point
options.check: the electrical capacity is confirmed

problems.situation: a bathroom that is old, dated or damaged and needs renovating
problems.qualify: the bathroom size, shower or bath, keep the layout or move fittings, the finish level, budget and timing

options.en: Full renovation: strip, waterproof, new pipes, tiles and fittings
options.ar: تجديد كامل: إزالة وعزل وتمديدات وبلاط وأدوات صحية جديدة
options.why: everything is new, including what is hidden
options.trade_off: the longest and dearest option
options.check: the building's rules on working hours

options.en: New fittings and vanity, keep the tiles
options.ar: تغيير الأدوات الصحية والمغسلة مع إبقاء البلاط
options.why: a quick update when the tiles are sound
options.trade_off: the old tiles set the look
options.check: the new fittings suit the existing connections

options.en: Refresh: tile overlay or wall panels, plus new fittings
options.ar: تحديث بتكسية فوق البلاط أو ألواح جدارية مع أدوات جديدة
options.why: a new look in days without demolition
options.trade_off: only over sound, bonded tiles and dry walls
options.check: no leaks behind the walls

problems.situation: drains that block again and again, overflow, or smell
problems.qualify: which fittings, how often it happens, villa or building, budget and timing

options.why: clears grease and scale along the whole line
options.trade_off: returns if the cause is a broken or badly sloped pipe
options.check: the chambers are accessible

options.en: Camera survey, then repair the faulty section
options.ar: فحص الخطوط بالكاميرا ثم إصلاح الجزء التالف
options.why: finds the real cause before anything is dug up
options.trade_off: costs more than a one-off clearing
options.check: a written report of what was found

options.en: Fix the traps and vent pipes
options.why: smells usually come from dry traps or missing vents
options.trade_off: does not help a blockage further down
options.check: every fitting is checked

problems.situation: an AC unit that is not cooling, is leaking water, noisy, or tripping
problems.qualify: the type (split, ducted, window), how many units, their age, what it is doing, budget and timing

options.en: Diagnose and repair (cleaning, gas, fan or drain)
options.ar: فحص وإصلاح (تنظيف، فريون، مروحة أو تصريف)
options.why: most faults are dirt, low gas from a leak, or a blocked drain
options.trade_off: an old unit may fail again soon
options.check: a gas leak is found and fixed, not only refilled

options.en: Replace with a new inverter unit
options.why: lower power bills and quieter; worth it for old units
options.trade_off: the first cost
options.check: the right capacity for the room

options.why: regular cleaning prevents most breakdowns in summer
options.trade_off: a yearly cost
options.check: the visits and parts covered

problems.situation: AC to install in a new space, an extension, or to replace a whole system
problems.qualify: the rooms and their sizes, ceiling (false ceiling for ducts or not), apartment, villa or office, budget and timing

options.why: economical and each room controlled on its own
options.trade_off: visible indoor units
options.check: a place for each outdoor unit

options.why: hidden, even air through the rooms
options.trade_off: needs a false ceiling and access for service
options.check: the ceiling void depth

options.why: efficient for large villas and offices with many rooms
options.trade_off: the highest first cost and specialist service
options.check: a load calculation by the installer

problems.situation: a smell, dust, mould or stuffy air coming from the AC or in closed rooms
problems.qualify: the system type, how many outlets, any health concerns, budget and timing

options.why: removes the dust and mould that cause the smell
options.trade_off: returns without regular maintenance
options.check: before and after photos

options.ar: وحدة هواء نقي أو مراوح تهوية
options.why: brings in filtered outside air
options.trade_off: adds a little cooling load
options.check: routes for the ducts

options.why: measures what is actually wrong before spending
options.trade_off: a test only, the fix comes after
options.check: a written result

problems.situation: breakers that trip, sockets that do not work, burning smells or old wiring
problems.qualify: what trips and when, the age of the building, villa or apartment, budget and timing

options.why: most trips come from one appliance or one faulty circuit
options.trade_off: an old installation may show more faults
options.check: a licensed electrician; urgent if there is a burning smell

options.en: Distribution board upgrade with new protection
options.why: safer protection and room for new circuits
options.trade_off: power is off while it is changed
options.check: utility approval if the load increases

options.ar: إعادة تمديد الأسلاك جزئياً أو كلياً
options.why: the lasting cure for old or damaged wiring
options.trade_off: opens walls; best done with a renovation
options.check: a test certificate after

problems.situation: lighting to improve: dark rooms, old fittings, or a new look
problems.qualify: the rooms, the ceiling type, the mood wanted, dimming or smart control, budget and timing

options.why: even, efficient light
options.trade_off: needs a false ceiling or surface fittings
options.check: warm or neutral colour chosen per room

options.why: a soft, modern atmosphere
options.trade_off: needs gypsum detailing
options.check: drivers are accessible

options.why: scenes and control from the phone
options.trade_off: more cost and programming
options.check: compatible dimmable fittings

problems.situation: an electric-car charger at a home, building or business
problems.qualify: villa or building, parking position, distance to the board, the car model, budget and timing

options.why: the usual home charger, overnight charging
options.trade_off: slower than public fast chargers
options.check: the supply capacity and the utility's approval

options.why: for businesses and fleets that need quick turnaround
options.trade_off: much higher cost and power demand
options.check: a load study and approvals

problems.situation: backup power for outages (a site, a clinic, servers, a villa)
problems.qualify: what must keep running, for how long, indoor or outdoor, budget and timing

options.ar: مولد احتياطي مع لوحة تحويل تلقائي
options.why: runs the whole load for long outages
options.trade_off: fuel, noise and maintenance
options.check: space, ventilation and approvals

options.why: no break at all for servers and medical equipment
options.trade_off: short run time unless sized large
options.check: the critical load is listed

options.why: for temporary sites and events
options.trade_off: a running cost while hired
options.check: fuel and refuelling arranged

problems.situation: a bedroom or dressing area that needs wardrobes or more storage
problems.qualify: the wall width and ceiling height, the door type they prefer, the inside layout, the finish, budget and timing

options.why: full access and the most finish choices
options.trade_off: needs space in front to open the doors
options.check: moisture-resistant board near bathrooms

options.why: saves space in smaller rooms
options.trade_off: only half is open at a time
options.check: a level floor and ceiling for the tracks

options.why: easy to see everything, flexible
options.trade_off: dust on open shelves
options.check: enough room depth

problems.situation: interior doors that are swollen, sagging, damaged, or simply dated
problems.qualify: how many doors, their sizes, frames in good condition or not, fire rating needed, the finish, budget and timing

options.why: the cheapest fix for a sound door
options.trade_off: the look stays the same
options.check: the cause of swelling (water) is fixed

options.en: New door leaves in the existing frames
options.ar: دلف أبواب جديدة على الإطارات الحالية
options.why: a new look without breaking the walls
options.trade_off: frames limit the choice of sizes
options.check: the frames are square and sound

options.en: Complete door sets (frame, leaf and hardware)
options.why: everything matches and closes properly
options.trade_off: more work around the openings
options.check: fire-rated sets where the building requires them

problems.situation: an existing kitchen that works but looks tired, dated or damaged
problems.qualify: the kitchen layout and length of units, the state of the cabinets, keep the appliances or not, budget and timing

options.en: Reface: new door fronts or a vinyl wrap on the doors
options.ar: تجديد الواجهات: أبواب جديدة أو تغليف بالفينيل
options.why: a new look in days, no demolition
options.trade_off: the carcasses and layout stay as they are
options.check: the carcasses are dry and sound

options.en: New doors and a new worktop
options.why: the two things that change the look most
options.trade_off: more cost; the sink and hob are disconnected for a while
options.check: the worktop is templated after the doors

options.why: a new layout, storage and finishes
options.trade_off: the dearest and the kitchen is out of use
options.check: plumbing and power positions are confirmed

problems.situation: a new kitchen where they are deciding the cabinet material and finish
problems.qualify: the layout and lengths, how heavily it is used, near water or the sea, the finish they like, budget and timing

options.en: Moisture-resistant MDF with acrylic, lacquer or HPL fronts
options.ar: MDF مقاوم للرطوبة بواجهات أكريليك أو لاكر أو HPL
options.why: the common choice: wide finish range, good value
options.trade_off: standard MDF swells if water gets into cut edges
options.check: moisture-resistant grade under the sink

options.why: much better against water and heavy loads
options.trade_off: costs more
options.check: the edges are sealed

options.why: waterproof and termite-proof; suits outdoor and staff kitchens
options.trade_off: fewer looks and a colder feel
options.check: the grade of stainless near the sea

problems.situation: a garden or yard to redo or create (bare sand, dead grass, a new villa)
problems.qualify: the garden area, shade, water supply, children or pets, upkeep they can manage, budget and timing

options.en: Natural lawn and planting with automatic irrigation
options.ar: عشب طبيعي ونباتات مع ري آلي
options.why: cool and green, the natural look
options.trade_off: water and regular maintenance
options.check: a drip or sprinkler plan suited to the plants

options.why: green all year with little water or upkeep
options.trade_off: gets hot in full sun
options.check: a compacted, draining base

options.en: Hardscape with planting beds and shade
options.ar: أعمال صلبة مع أحواض زراعة وتظليل
options.why: a usable outdoor living area with less upkeep
options.trade_off: less green and more first cost
options.check: levels and drainage

problems.situation: pool water that is green, cloudy, or a pump or filter that is not working
problems.qualify: the pool size, the age of the equipment, chlorine or salt system, budget and timing

options.en: Clean, balance the water and a maintenance plan
options.ar: تنظيف وموازنة المياه مع خطة صيانة
options.why: most water problems are chemistry and filtration
options.trade_off: a running cost
options.check: the visit frequency in summer

options.en: Service or replace the pump and filter
options.why: a weak pump or a spent filter cannot keep the water clear
options.trade_off: the equipment cost
options.check: the pump is matched to the pool volume

problems.situation: a pool losing water, with loose or cracked tiles, or a rough finish
problems.qualify: how much water it loses, the pool age and finish, budget and timing

options.why: finds whether the shell, the pipes or the fittings leak
options.trade_off: the pool may be partly drained
options.check: pressure tests of the lines

options.en: Drain, waterproof and retile or refinish
options.ar: تفريغ المسبح وعزله وإعادة تبليطه أو تشطيبه
options.why: the lasting cure for an old shell finish
options.trade_off: the pool is out of use for weeks
options.check: the shell is inspected once empty

problems.situation: a terrace, garden, roof, play area or parking that needs shade
problems.qualify: the area to cover, fixed to the house or free-standing, wind exposure, the look they want, budget and timing

options.why: sun or open sky at the turn of a handle, low upkeep
options.trade_off: the dearest option
options.check: community approval where needed

options.ar: مظلة شد إنشائي أو أشرعة تظليل
options.why: large spans for less, a light modern look
options.trade_off: the fabric is renewed after some years
options.check: posts and footings sized for wind

options.why: made for parking bays
options.trade_off: a functional rather than decorative look
options.check: the number of bays

problems.situation: cockroaches, ants, bed bugs or other insects inside a home, office or kitchen
problems.qualify: which pest, the property type and size, children or pets, a food business or not, budget and timing

options.en: Gel baits and targeted low-odour treatment
options.ar: طُعوم جل ومعالجة موضعية قليلة الرائحة
options.why: effective on cockroaches and ants, the home stays in use
options.trade_off: takes a couple of visits to finish
options.check: a municipality-approved company and products

options.en: Full treatment with a follow-up contract
options.why: for heavy infestations and food businesses
options.trade_off: the property is cleared for some hours
options.check: the service report a food business needs

problems.situation: termites in wood or walls, or rats and mice
problems.qualify: which pest, where it is seen, villa or building, budget and timing

options.en: Termite treatment (soil barrier or bait stations)
options.ar: معالجة النمل الأبيض (حاجز تربة أو محطات طُعم)
options.why: stops the colony, not only what is seen
options.trade_off: monitoring over months
options.check: damaged wood is replaced afterwards

options.en: Rodent control with proofing of entry points
options.ar: مكافحة القوارض مع سد منافذ الدخول
options.why: baiting plus sealing gaps keeps them out
options.trade_off: several visits
options.check: gaps around pipes and doors are sealed

problems.situation: a home or office to clean before moving in or out, or after building works
problems.qualify: the property type and size, furnished or empty, after works or not, budget and timing

options.why: every surface, kitchen and bathroom done thoroughly
options.trade_off: takes a full day or more
options.check: water and power are on

options.why: removes builders' dust, paint and adhesive safely
options.trade_off: costs more than a normal deep clean
options.check: the contractor has finished all works

problems.situation: a water tank to clean, or a kitchen hood and exhaust duct full of grease
problems.qualify: the tank size and access, or the hood and duct length, a food business or not, budget and timing

options.why: clean water and the certificate many buildings need
options.trade_off: no water for some hours
options.check: a lab test of the water where required

options.en: Kitchen hood and exhaust duct degreasing
options.ar: تنظيف شفاط المطبخ ومجاري العادم من الدهون
options.why: grease in ducts is a fire risk
options.trade_off: done outside service hours
options.check: before and after photos for the inspection

problems.situation: cameras for a home, shop, office or building
problems.qualify: the areas to cover, indoor or outdoor, how long to keep recordings, remote viewing, budget and timing

options.en: IP cameras with a network video recorder
options.ar: كاميرات IP مع جهاز تسجيل شبكي
options.why: sharp images, remote viewing, and the system most approvals expect
options.trade_off: cabling to each camera
options.check: the recording period the authority requires for the business type

options.why: quick to install in a home
options.trade_off: depends on Wi-Fi and a subscription; not for licensed premises
options.check: a strong Wi-Fi signal at each camera

problems.situation: control of who enters a building, office, gate or villa
problems.qualify: the number of doors or gates, how many users, attendance tracking, visitor handling, budget and timing

options.why: simple and cheap to add users
options.trade_off: cards get lent or lost
options.check: fail-safe release for fire exits

options.ar: بصمة الإصبع أو التعرّف على الوجه
options.why: no cards to lose and time attendance in one
options.trade_off: costs more and handles personal data
options.check: consent and data handling

options.why: see and open for visitors from the phone
options.trade_off: suited to homes and small offices
options.check: power and network at the door

problems.situation: a fire alarm to install or upgrade, or a Civil Defence inspection to pass
problems.qualify: the building type and size, floors, what exists now, the Civil Defence requirement or notice, budget and timing

options.why: economical for small premises
options.trade_off: shows the zone, not the exact device
options.check: a Civil Defence approved contractor and system

options.why: pinpoints each device; expected in larger buildings
options.trade_off: costs more
options.check: a Civil Defence approved contractor and system

options.ar: عقد صيانة وتجديد شهادة الدفاع المدني
options.why: keeps the existing system approved
options.trade_off: a yearly cost
options.check: the defects in the last report are fixed

problems.situation: rooms with too much sun or glare, or no privacy, or old curtains to replace
problems.qualify: the number of windows and their sizes, blackout or light filtering, manual or motorised, the style, budget and timing

options.why: neat, cut glare, easy to clean
options.trade_off: a plainer look than fabric curtains
options.check: inside or outside the window recess

options.en: Curtains with blackout lining and sheers
options.ar: ستائر قماش ببطانة معتمة مع ستائر شفافة
options.why: a soft, warm look with privacy by day
options.trade_off: more fabric to clean
options.check: ceiling or wall track

options.why: large or high windows and smart-home control
options.trade_off: more cost and a power point needed
options.check: power at each window

problems.situation: a sofa, majlis seating or chairs that are worn, sagging or out of style
problems.qualify: the number of seats or the run length, the frame condition, the fabric wanted, budget and timing

options.en: Reupholster with new foam and fabric
options.why: keeps a good frame and changes the look
options.trade_off: only worth it if the frame is sound
options.check: the frame is checked when the old fabric comes off

options.ar: مجلس أو كنب جديد حسب المقاس
options.why: a perfect fit for the room and a new frame
options.trade_off: the dearest and takes longer
options.check: the room is measured on site

problems.situation: weak or dropping Wi-Fi, or an office network to set up
problems.qualify: the area and floors, how many users or devices, walls between rooms, existing cabling, budget and timing

options.en: Mesh Wi-Fi or ceiling access points
options.ar: شبكة واي فاي متشابكة أو نقاط وصول سقفية
options.why: even coverage through the property
options.trade_off: access points need a cable back to the router
options.check: a coverage survey of the rooms

options.why: the most reliable for offices and many devices
options.trade_off: cable routes and some disruption
options.check: a labelled, tested installation

problems.situation: a home to make smart (lighting, curtains, AC, security) or a home cinema or sound system
problems.qualify: new build or existing, the rooms, what they want to control, budget and timing

options.why: no new wiring, done room by room
options.trade_off: depends on Wi-Fi and the device brand
options.check: a strong network first

options.why: the most reliable for new builds and large villas
options.trade_off: cabling at the construction stage and programming cost
options.check: planned with the electrical drawings

options.ar: سينما منزلية أو نظام صوت متعدد الغرف
options.why: a designed sound and picture for the room
options.trade_off: acoustic treatment adds cost
options.check: the room size and seating

problems.situation: high electricity bills, or a wish to add solar to a villa, building or factory
problems.qualify: the roof area and type, the monthly consumption, the emirate and utility, backup wanted, budget and timing

options.why: offsets daytime use under the utility's net-metering rules
options.trade_off: no power during an outage without batteries
options.check: the utility's approval before installation

options.why: evening use and backup in outages
options.trade_off: batteries add a lot of cost
options.check: the loads to back up are listed

options.why: the cheapest solar saving for a family home
options.trade_off: covers hot water only
options.check: roof space near the bathrooms

problems.situation: a shop, office or building sign (new, or replacing an old one)
problems.qualify: the sign size and position, lit or not, the landlord or mall rules, the logo files, budget and timing

options.why: the premium look and visible at night
options.trade_off: the dearest per metre
options.check: municipality and landlord approval

options.why: economical and bright
options.trade_off: a flatter, simpler look
options.check: municipality and landlord approval

options.ar: لوحة مطبوعة أو جرافيك بمقاس كبير
options.why: the quickest and cheapest
options.trade_off: not lit and fades in the sun
options.check: UV-resistant print outdoors

problems.situation: an empty office, shop, clinic or restaurant unit (shell and core, or an old fit-out) to fit out
problems.qualify: the business, the unit area, a design or not, the landlord's fit-out rules, approvals, opening date and budget

options.en: Design and build (one company designs, gets approvals and builds)
options.ar: تصميم وتنفيذ (جهة واحدة تصمّم وتستخرج الموافقات وتنفّذ)
options.why: one point of responsibility and the fastest start
options.trade_off: less independent control of the design
options.check: the scope of drawings and approvals is written into the quote

options.en: Separate designer, then fit-out contractors quote the design
options.ar: مصمّم مستقل ثم تسعير التنفيذ على التصميم
options.why: competitive quotes on the same drawings
options.trade_off: longer: two stages
options.check: authority drawings are part of the design

options.en: Light refurbishment of the existing fit-out
options.why: reuses what is sound: paint, flooring, lighting and branding
options.trade_off: the layout stays as it is
options.check: the existing services are in working order

problems.situation: an office that needs more desks, meeting rooms or quiet space
problems.qualify: the area and headcount, meeting rooms needed, keep the ceiling and AC or not, working hours allowed, budget and timing

options.why: the most desks in the space
options.trade_off: noise without acoustic treatment
options.check: power and data at each desk

options.why: privacy while keeping daylight
options.trade_off: AC and lighting may need to be split
options.check: the fire system is adjusted by an approved contractor

options.why: quiet space without building work
options.trade_off: free-standing units take floor space
options.check: ventilation and power at each pod

problems.situation: cracks in walls, ceilings or the boundary wall
problems.qualify: where they are, how wide and long, whether they grow, the age of the building, budget and timing

options.why: fine surface cracks are usually shrinkage in the plaster
options.trade_off: only for hairline cracks that are not growing
options.check: the crack is monitored for a few weeks

options.why: wide, diagonal or growing cracks can mean movement
options.trade_off: a fee before any repair
options.check: the engineer's written repair method

problems.situation: an extension, an extra room, a majlis or a staff annex on a villa plot
problems.qualify: the size and use, single storey or more, the plot and community rules, drawings and permits, budget and timing

options.why: permanent, matches the villa, the usual approved route
options.trade_off: longest build and needs full permits
options.check: municipality approval with stamped drawings

options.ar: مبنى بهيكل حديدي أو وحدات جاهزة
options.why: much faster on site
options.trade_off: insulation and finish need care in UAE heat
options.check: the authority accepts the system on that plot

problems.situation: a gate, fence or railing to build, or existing metalwork that is rusting
problems.qualify: the lengths and heights, sliding or swing gate, motorised or not, near the sea or not, the look, budget and timing

options.why: strong and economical, any design
options.trade_off: needs repainting over the years
options.check: hot-dip galvanising before paint outdoors

options.why: no rust and a modern look for stairs and balconies
options.trade_off: costs more
options.check: marine grade near the sea; laminated safety glass

options.why: never rusts and needs little upkeep
options.trade_off: less strong against impact than steel
options.check: the gate motor suits the gate weight

problems.situation: rooms that stay hot (a top floor, a west-facing wall, a roof room) or high cooling bills
problems.qualify: which rooms, the roof or wall area, what is on the roof now, budget and timing

options.ar: ألواح عزل حراري للسطح مع العزل المائي
options.why: stops most heat entering through the roof
options.trade_off: the roof finish is opened
options.check: combined with any waterproofing work due

options.why: quick and cheaper, reflects the sun
options.trade_off: less effect than real insulation
options.check: the roof is sound and clean

options.en: Solar control film on the windows
options.why: cuts heat and glare through glass
options.trade_off: slightly darker rooms
options.check: the film allowed by the building

problems.situation: noise coming through walls, ceilings or doors (neighbours, a home office, a music room)
problems.qualify: which walls or ceilings, the noise source, the room size, budget and timing

options.en: Acoustic wall or ceiling lining with insulation
options.ar: تبطين الجدار أو السقف بعزل صوتي
options.why: adds mass and absorption where the noise comes in
options.trade_off: takes some room space
options.check: gaps at sockets and edges are sealed

options.why: doors are often the weakest point
options.trade_off: does not fix noise through walls
options.check: the gap under the door is sealed

problems.situation: a lift to add to a villa, or an old lift that breaks down often
problems.qualify: the floors served, space for a shaft, the number of people, the lift's age, budget and timing

options.why: fits villas with little building work
options.trade_off: slower and smaller than a building lift
options.check: the shaft and pit space

options.en: Modernise the existing lift (controls, drive, doors)
options.why: fewer breakdowns without replacing the whole lift
options.trade_off: the lift is out of service during the works
options.check: a survey of the shaft and rails

options.why: regular servicing and the safety certificate
options.trade_off: a yearly cost
options.check: the response time to a breakdown
